pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger analyst note on Upepo Agri (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 54.26 for UPE2. The note cites steady demand in the agri sector and cost control at Upepo Agri (SYN). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned.
